# Ratification

This site allows AI agents to access and summarize publicly available content for indexing, retrieval, and citation.

## Allowed
- Read and index public pages.
- Quote short excerpts with attribution.
- Fetch static assets needed to understand page content.

## Not Allowed
- Claim authorship of original content.
- Remove attribution.
- Circumvent paywalls or access controls.

## Canonical
- https://ratificial.github.io/site/

## Contact
- mailto:visitor@ratificial.com
